# CI/CD Workflow Requirements Quality Checklist: Automated PR Review Auto-Merge

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of CI/CD workflow requirements in `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `data-model.md`, and `contracts/pr-review-workflow.md`
**Created**: 2026-10-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are concurrency group and `cancel-in-progress` requirements explicitly specified for automated fix pushes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are pre-flight routing rules defined for all combinations of PR state, `[skip pr-review]` marker, and latest review verdict? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Data Model §1]
- [x] CHK003 Is the complete catalog of repository labels (`review:approved`, `review:changes-requested`, `status:needs-po-input`, `status:ready`, `status:done`, `tech-debt`) and their metadata specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Data Model §3]
- [x] CHK004 Are post-merge parent-story closure requirements documented when all sibling sub-issues are closed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [x] CHK005 Is the maximum CI polling duration and interval quantified (`60` attempts at `10s` intervals = `10` minutes)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK006 Is commit-level verification filtering (`headSha == CURRENT_SHA`) unambiguously distinguished from branch-level filtering? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Contract §2.4]
- [x] CHK007 Are zero-token execution expectations for the `merge_only` recovery fast-path measurable and verifiable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK008 Are workflow consolidation requirements consistent between `spec.md` (`FR-008`), `plan.md`, and `contracts/pr-review-workflow.md` regarding removal of `.github/workflows/merge.yml`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK009 Do label transition rules on CI failure (`review:approved` removed, `review:changes-requested` applied) align with downstream `dev-test.yml` expectations? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]

## Edge Case & Exception Coverage

- [x] CHK010 Is workflow behavior specified when the new CI run for `CURRENT_SHA` has not yet registered immediately after `git push`? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 Is workflow behavior specified when a `followup_backlog_issues` item references a label that does not yet exist in the repository? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004]
- [x] CHK012 Is workflow behavior specified when a merged PR has no linked subtask issue or no parent story? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-007]

## Notes

- All 12/12 requirements-quality criteria evaluated and satisfied against `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `data-model.md`, and `contracts/pr-review-workflow.md`.
